name: Jazz duo playing There Will Never Be Another You on guitar and upright bass
seoTitle: Jazz duo: There Will Never Be Another You
description: Watch our jazz duo play There Will Never Be Another You on guitar and upright bass. It's one of the jazz standards on our song list.
more: If there's a standard you'd love to hear, just let us know when you reach out. The duo also plays songs like Misty, Days of Wine and Roses and Someday My Prince Will Come, and we can put the song list together with you.
